title: Add two numbers
prompt: Return the sum of a and b.
hint: Think about the arithmetic operator that combines two values.

title: Even or odd
prompt: Return true when n is even.
hint: Check the remainder after dividing by two.

title: Larger number
prompt: Return the larger of a and b. If they are equal, return that value.
hint: Compare the inputs before choosing which value to return.

title: Absolute value
prompt: Return the absolute value of n.
hint: Consider the sign of n and what should happen to zero.

title: Clamp a value
prompt: Return n if it lies between low and high, inclusive. Otherwise return the closest bound. Assume low is at most high.
hint: Handle the two out-of-range cases before the in-range case.

title: Sum from 1 to n
prompt: Return the sum of the integers from 1 to n, inclusive. Assume 0 <= n <= 1000.
hint: Start an accumulator at zero and add one integer at a time.

title: Factorial
prompt: Return n factorial for 0 <= n <= 10. By definition, 0 factorial is 1.
hint: Use 1 as the initial product, then multiply by each positive integer up to n.

title: Count digits
prompt: Return the number of decimal digits in the nonnegative integer n. Zero has one digit.
hint: You can count the characters in the decimal representation, or repeatedly divide by 10.

title: Sum an array
prompt: Return the sum of all numbers in nums. Return zero for an empty array.
hint: Keep a running total as you visit the elements.

title: Maximum of an array
prompt: Return the largest number in the nonempty array nums.
hint: Initialize your best value with the first element so negative values work.

title: Count positive numbers
prompt: Return how many elements of nums are strictly greater than zero.
hint: Increment a counter only when the current element meets the comparison.

title: Find the first index
prompt: Return the first zero-based index of target in nums, or -1 if it is absent.
hint: Scan from left to right and return as soon as you find a match.

title: Reverse an array
prompt: Return the numbers of nums in reverse order.
hint: You can walk backward through the original array or swap pairs from the ends.

title: Check sorted order
prompt: Return true when nums is in nondecreasing order. Equal neighbors and empty arrays are allowed.
hint: Look for an adjacent pair in which the first number is greater than the second.

title: Reverse a string
prompt: Return text reversed. The input contains only ASCII characters.
hint: Collect the characters starting from the end.

title: Check a palindrome
prompt: Return true when the ASCII string text reads the same from either direction. Comparisons are case-sensitive.
hint: Compare characters from opposite ends, or compare the text with its reverse.

title: Count vowels
prompt: Return how many ASCII vowels (a, e, i, o, u) appear in text. Ignore case.
hint: Normalize each character before checking whether it belongs to the set of vowels.

title: Length of the last word
prompt: Return the number of characters in the final word of text. Words are separated by ASCII spaces. Return zero if text has no words.
hint: Walk backward over trailing spaces, then count characters until the next space.

title: First unique character
prompt: Return the first ASCII character that occurs only once in text, or an empty string if none exists. Comparisons are case-sensitive.
hint: Count occurrences first, then scan in original order.

title: Merge sorted arrays
prompt: Return a nondecreasing array containing all values from the already sorted arrays a and b. Preserve duplicate values.
hint: Track the next unused position in each array and take the smaller remaining value.
